fib: ______ is the principal law on crimes it can be found in numerous federal Acts and state laws.

Branch

______ is responsible for the crimes he commits.
offending police officer
An offending police officer is responsible for the crimes he commits.
______ is a court or an adjudicatory body or a place where a judge sits.
Tribunal
A Tribunal is a court or an adjudicatory body or a place where a judge sits.
______ is the Supreme law over all persons, who observe it and over all issues to which Islamic law applies.
Holy Qu'ran
The Holy Qu'ran is the Supreme law over all persons, who observe it and over all issues to which Islamic law applies.
______ is the taking and restraining of a person from his or her liberty in order that he or she shall be forthcoming to answer to an alleged or suspected crime or offence.
Arrest
Arrest is the taking and restraining of a person from his or her liberty in order that he or she shall be forthcoming to answer to an alleged or suspected crime or offence.

Arraignment
Arraignment is the initial step in a criminal prosecution whereby the accused person is brought before the court to hear the charge or charges and to enter a plea.
